questions.q: What practice does Bernstein recommend for 12 minutes daily?
questions.why: She suggests practicing Kirtan Kriya daily.

questions.q: According to Bernstein, what is needed before asking the Universe for desires?
a: A prepared mind free of negativity
questions.why: You must prepare your mind free of negativity.

questions.q: What does Bernstein say about worldly pleasures?
a: They are the key to happiness
They are the only source of joy
questions.why: Worldly pleasures cannot replace spiritual maturity.

questions.q: Which philosophy is cited as teaching to avoid stress over uncontrollable outcomes?
questions.why: Stoicism teaches not to stress over uncontrollable outcomes.

questions.q: What does Bernstein identify as a major cause of anxiety?
questions.why: Disconnection from a higher power causes anxiety.
